These locks were generated by the named, unmodified PDM releases against PyPI on 2026-09-17. The direct project pins urllib3 1.26.18; the extras projects request urllib3[socks]. Versions cover every stable PDM major family and each relevant 2.x lock format boundary.

The shared hosted/vendored rewriter supports lock versions 2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.4.1, 4.5.0 and 4.5.1, including legacy metadata.files and separate extras entries. Native PDM 1.15.5 and 2.0–2.7 lose URL/path candidate identity before dependency lookup; their formats 3.1/4.0/4.1/4.2 refuse before any write. Future formats also refuse until tested.

PDM 0.x requires `pdm sync`: its own freshly generated locks with inline dependency specifications can fail its freshness check, so ordinary `pdm install` can regenerate them and discard redirects. The CLI warns for this format. Explicit re-lock/update can discard lock-only patches on any version; rerun Socket after changing dependencies.

Pure rewriter tests validate all supported versions with LF/CRLF, hosted URLs, POSIX and Windows path spellings, both base/extras integrity tables, repeated rewrites, exact rollback, source conflicts, malformed hashes and unsupported formats. Native installer backtests live in the companion depscan PR and verify actual patched file hashes, integrity rejection, repeated scans, unchanged manifests, rollback and Windows/Linux execution.
